name: WaypointPatrol
src_typeComment: Assign a list of waypoints and this object walks between them — no code required for basic patrol AI. Uses Quaternion.LookRotation for facing, which assumes 3D forward-facing; for 2D, replace that one line with a Vector2-angle rotation (or just turn faceMovementDirection off and handle facing yourself).

src_serialized.name: waypoints
src_serialized.tooltip: Points visited in order. Assign at least 2.

src_serialized.name: arrivalDistance
src_serialized.tooltip: How close (units) counts as \"arrived\" at a waypoint.

src_serialized.name: waitTimeAtWaypoint
src_serialized.tooltip: Seconds to pause at each waypoint before moving to the next.

src_serialized.name: mode
src_serialized.tooltip: Loop = restart at 0 after the last point. PingPong = reverse direction. Once = stop after the last point.

src_serialized.name: faceMovementDirection
src_serialized.tooltip: Rotates this object to face its movement direction (3D).

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<int> OnWaypointReached = new UnityEvent<int>(); // index reached
src_members.name: UnityEvent

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent OnPatrolFinished = new UnityEvent();        // fires once, only in Once mode
src_members.name: UnityEvent
CurrentWaypointIndex
src_members.comment: Lets other systems (e.g. a minimap icon, an AI director) query patrol progress without their own bookkeeping.

src_members.name: SetWaypoints
src_members.comment: Reassigns the patrol route at runtime, e.g. for a dynamically generated or randomized route. Restarts from the first waypoint of the new route.
